verdict.rationale: Riskified explicitly extends beyond checkout with a dedicated Login/Account-Secure API that scores account-takeover attempts (allow/notify/challenge) and a Policy Protect module that issues approve/review/decline recommendations for claims (return/policy abuse), all managed via the same platform and notification infrastructure as checkout decisioning. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of fake-account-creation scoring or promo-abuse detection as distinct managed surfaces. missing for 10: explicit fake-account-creation protection, explicit promo-abuse detection/management.
